results.title: Spokeo Review (2026): Is It Worth Paying For?
results.content:
## MobileAppDaily’s Final Verdict on Spokeo

After going through the pricing, the complaint patterns, and how Spokeo stacks up against BeenVerified and TruthFinder, our honest read is that Spokeo does what it says on the tin,  it just doesn't always say the full thing upfront.

The search itself works. It returns real data pulled from real public records, the interface is genuinely easy to use even for someone who's never run a background search before, and for a single, well-timed lookup, it's hard to beat on price.

That's nothing, and it's why a meaningful share of users walk away satisfied. Where we can't give Spokeo phone lookup tool a pass is the billing experience, because it's not an isolated complaint or a one-off bad review. [...] On the positive side, a smaller but real share of reviewers report the service working as expected: finding old contacts, confirming an address, or identifying an unknown caller, with no billing issues at all.

### How Accurate is Spokeo?

Because Spokeo aggregates rather than originates data, its accuracy is only as good as its sources, and those sources aren't always current. Common complaints include outdated addresses, phone numbers reassigned to new owners, and stale employment or relationship data. [...] Spokeo's official position, repeated in company responses to complaints, is that since services are prepaid and non-retroactive, cancellation stops future billing but doesn't refund time already paid for; partial refunds appear to be offered case-by-case rather than as a stated policy.

#### 3. Difficulty canceling or reaching support

Along with complaints related to the Spokeo background check cost, many reviews also have complained about long hold times, unclear cancellation flows, and cases of continued billing after a stated cancellation are recurring complaints in Spokeo reviews from 2025 into mid-2026.
